title: Preserve exact Staging Gateway execution-plan expiry under MariaDB TIMESTAMP(0)

phases.objective: Make the canonical plan-body expiry, SQL TIMESTAMP(0) binding, and persisted readback equal to the same UTC whole-second instant before Cloudflare certification writes.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed Staging Activation Gateway transaction certification
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Generate dry-run and certification plans against the canonical Staging Gateway profile.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Expiry instant is rounded up to a whole second before digest construction; SQL persistence rejects subsecond plans; simulated TIMESTAMP(0) readback matches the canonical plan body with no provider or Production mutation.
steps: Build dry-run and independent transaction-certification plans for exact source SHA and Staging policy hash.
Assert canonical plan expiry is a whole-second UTC instant before SHA-256 digest construction.
Persist a certification plan through the governed SQL-binding path using a Date object.
Simulate MariaDB TIMESTAMP(0) fractional-second truncation and verify the persisted expiry matches plan_body_json.
Preserve the live non-Production certification requirement before merging; never treat synthetic test as Cloudflare certification.
assertions: All plan expiry timestamps are aligned to MariaDB TIMESTAMP(0) precision.
The SQL binding preserves the digest-bound whole-second expiry with zero drift.
Invalid subsecond expiry is rejected before database persistence.
Provider/DNS/custom-domain/Production mutation remains forbidden in this synthetic test.
Live Staging Gateway certification remains a separate required follow-up with exact-source authority.
